svg.title: Permission to Return — Future Museum exhibit card
svg.text: House key · c. 2026 · worn brass, skin polish,
The polished bow records where one thumb found the
same circle each evening. Its teeth admitted a single
person to a private interior whose walls no longer
survive. Researchers cannot locate the lock, but the
wear suggests the owner expected the door to open.
The lock disappeared before the habit of returning.
